_about: NFR-06: reviewed exceptions to the npm audit job (scripts/npm-audit.mjs). Each entry needs a reason and a review_by date (at most 90 days ahead); past that date it fails CI again.

entries.reason: Used by @expo/cli for development-server and code-signing certificates. Not part of the app bundle or any server; upgrade with the next Expo SDK that moves off node-forge 1.4.
Pulled in by developer CLIs (shadcn / MCP tooling used only to generate UI components). Never part of the web bundle, the POS app or any server; no request ever reaches it in production.
Used by the shadcn and Expo command-line tools at build time only (zod 3 has no fixed 3.x release for @expo/cli). Not in the web bundle, the POS app or any server.
